title: Complete official registration/status process
description: Use the official PM-KISAN portal and follow the current registration instructions.

title: Check notified crop and season
description: Confirm that the crop, area and season are covered under the applicable notification.

title: Enrol through the applicable channel
description: Use the official PMFBY portal or the applicable state/bank/service channel.

title: Choose a participating bank
description: Review the bank's KCC process and requirements.

title: Submit the KCC application
description: Provide the documents requested by the bank.

title: Arrange soil testing
description: Follow local agriculture department/soil testing instructions.

title: Receive and use soil recommendations
description: Use the soil report recommendations for crop and nutrient planning.
